profile.headline: Sr. Web Developer at Columbia Sportswear Company
profile.summary:
Specialties: Web development using PHP, Javascript and AJAX, HTML5, CSS, MySQL, PostgreSQL

Proficient with development tools such as phpMyAdmin, Subversion, CVS, Git, Vim, WebStorm, Eclipse, Grunt

Creative graphics for the web and/or print using Photoshop, Illustrator, Fireworks, InDesign

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Front-end web development for Columbia Sportswear's eCommerce sites: Columbia Sportswear, Mountain Hardwear, Sorel, and Montrail for United States, Canada and Europe.

Maintain and develop features and content for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (formerly Demandware), as well as provide system support to minimize disruption to business.

Implement and maintain front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager, enabling us to deliver experiences that are responsive and relevant to our customers.

Technologies and Skills: 
-HTML5, LESS and SASS, ISML, Sightly, CoffeeScript and Javascript
-Responsive design, Object-oriented CSS (OOCSS) and Block-Element-Modifier (BEM) methodologies
-Agile: Experience conducting stand-ups, reviews/demos and retrospective ceremonies

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description: Professional and versatile web developer with over 10 years of experience in front-end development for SaaS, content management and e-commerce platforms.

positions.title: Co-Founder, Sales & Marketing
positions.description: Co-founded True and Pure Foods, LLC. and led the launch of our first product: Caju Cream. Responsibilities include product formulation, brand development and marketing, developing direct and wholesale relationships, designing our manufacturing process and distribution.

positions.title: Sr.Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed and programmed a web-based order acquisition tool that was part of a key initiative to store, edit, import and print accounting records for government contract eyeglass orders. 

Designed and built websites to revitalize two separate retail brands and increase traffic for 24 retail stores. Achieved a 120% increase in web traffic and over 1200 online appointments scheduled after one year. 

Established our first social media marketing initiatives, including weekly email blasts and online customer surveys; Initiated a process for engaging customers on popular social media platforms such as Facebook, Yelp and Google+ while providing guidelines for online reputation management; also managed multiple Groupon campaigns.

Designed and developed a new corporate website to better reflect the growth in products and services that the company has to offer. The new site resulted in an increase in web traffic of over 100% in less in a year.

Rebranded two existing vision plan programs, designed print collateral and promotional gift cards. Also designed and built websites to promote and engage customers for both programs.

Designed new brand mark for FrameofChoice.com; researched and documented requirements for the ecommerce site, including HIPAA and PCLI compliance.

Launched and configured ecommerce website at GPLC.rochesteroptical.com, creating a profitable new channel for the company.

positions.title: Web, Senior Interface Designer
positions.description:
Implemented user-centered design (UCD) principles to maintain an intuitive, yet innovative user experience for cloud-based applications.

Worked closely with sales and marketing team to define branding guidelines and establish visual appeal for parent company and subsidiary brands. 

Designed custom icons and graphical user interfaces for web applications and frameworks. 

Developed high-impact and engaging graphics for web, email and print marketing campaigns.

Increased web traffic through effective search engine optimization (SEO) and social media marketing, and helped grow online inquiries and acquisitions by designing and coding effective landing pages and web forms.

positions.title: Web Developer, Interface Designer
positions.description:
Designed and developed a mobile application for mobile devices supporting Wireless Application Protocol (WAP 2.0).

Introduced a fresh new visual look-and-feel for web application to update brand identity and attract new business.

Designed and implemented a framework for private-labeling web and mobile applications for resellers and Internet service providers (ISPs). 

Devised performance optimizations that improved data delivery to the customer-base of a large, overseas ISP.

Used Asynchronous JavaScript and XML (AJAX) to develop user interface prototypes; also developed prototypes that added support for internationalization.

positions.title: Website, Graphic Design Specialist
positions.description:
Designed and developed a company and product website targeting small-to-midsized businesses (SMBs).

Designed the user interface for a cloud-based email application, online file storage application, contact management tool, and online calendar.

Designed compelling print, web and email creatives to support various marketing campaigns.

positions.title: Website Designer
positions.description:
Responsible for updating the corporate website with new content, product photography, and custom designed web and print graphics.

Reinvigorated company’s brand story by expanding web site content to highlight its cutting-edge products and services, as well as its rich history.

Designed and produced compelling flyers, brochures and print ads for sales promotion items.

positions.title: Interactive Media Intern
positions.description:
Developed interactive CD-ROMs and websites for client/internal distribution. 

Designed and implemented web components for corporate intranet and web campaigns using JavaScript and DHTML.

Managed promotional ad campaign project for Oracle OpenWorld 98.
